_doc: Each creature eats, plays and reacts its own way (chot 24/10/2026; the fire creatures and Kim were drawn earlier with the shared poses of LOI-NHAC-KHUNG-PHU.md and stay so). Cells follow LAYOUTS['extra'] in scripts/slice_frames.py: eat = eat-look, eat-bite, eat-chew, eat-lick; play = play-crouch, play-jump, play-air, play-spin, play-land, play-cheer. 'who' goes in the prompt; 'motion' sets the timing of its anims (jump / ground / float; slow / fast).

moc-hung.who: Moc Hung, a wood element bear with a sprout on its head
eat: sniffing the food on the floor with its round nose
scooping it up with both big paws to its mouth
munching with stuffed round cheeks, the sprout on its head wiggling
sitting back and patting its round belly, content
play: rolling onto its back, paws up
rocking side to side on its back, giggling
curled up rolling forward like a ball
standing on its hind legs with arms wide open for a big hug
plopping down on its bottom with a bounce
both paws up cheering, a tiny flower blooming on its sprout
moc-hung.refuse: covering its mouth with both paws and turning away
moc-hung.petted: leaning into the touch, eyes closed, a tiny flower blooming on its sprout
moc-hung.sad: sitting with ears down and its sprout wilted
moc-hung.angry: standing up tall, growling, leaves bristling

moc-loc.who: Moc Loc, a wood element deer with leaf antlers
eat: gracefully lowering its neck toward the food on the floor
licking its nose, tail flicking happily
play: play bow, front legs down, rump up
high in the air, all four legs tucked, leaf antlers glowing
a graceful sideways leap, body twisting
landing lightly on the tips of its hooves
rearing up on its hind legs happily
moc-loc.refuse: lifting its head high and turning its nose away
moc-loc.petted: eyes closed, nuzzling upward, ears relaxed
moc-loc.wave: lifting one front hoof to say hello
moc-loc.sad: lying folded with its head down, ears drooping
moc-loc.angry: stamping a hoof and lowering its antlers

moc-duong.who: Moc Duong, a wood element leaf mantis
eat: eyes locked on the food on the floor, antennae twitching
snatching it with a lightning fast strike of its forearms
holding the bite up to its mouth, nibbling very fast
cleaning its forearms and antennae, satisfied
play: swaying side to side in a kung fu stance
leaping forward, leaf wings buzzing open
spinning roundhouse kick in the air
moc-duong.refuse: crossing its forearms in an X

thu-nhan.who: Thu Nhan, a wood element seed sprout creature that grows into a tree giant
eat: its little root feet wiggling toward the food
digging its roots into the food on the floor
glowing green while absorbing it, leaves perking up
a new leaf sprouting on its head, very happy
play: spinning on the spot like a top, leaves whirling
a little dance swinging its leaf arms
planting its feet, arms up like branches
thu-nhan.refuse: folding its leaves over its face

reu-linh.who: Reu Linh, a wood element round moss creature
eat: rolling closer and staring at the food
its mossy body opening wide to swallow it
squishy chewing, the whole body bulging
moss fluffing up, tiny flowers popping out
play: bouncing up like a rubber ball
tiny flowers blooming on top, cheering

diep-linh.who: Diep Linh, a wood element leaf sprite
eat: its leaf hair wrapping around the food
play: gathering wind, leaves swirling around it
riding a big leaf like a surfboard
twirling in a whirlwind of leaves
arms open, petals raining around it
diep-linh.refuse: hiding behind a leaf like a shield

moc-tru.who: Moc Tru, a wood element boar with a melon striped body
eat: lying on its side rubbing its belly, a happy burp
play: digging the ground with its front hooves
moc-tru.refuse: snout up, eyes shut, turning away
moc-tru.petted: flopping on its back, eyes closed

thuy-sa.who: Thuy Sa, a water element shark
eat: a big chomp with wide jaws
licking its teeth with a big grin
play: spinning with a ring of water splash
thuy-sa.refuse: clamping its mouth shut, fins crossed
thuy-sa.petted: blushing, eyes closed, tail fin wagging

thuy-giai.who: Thuy Giai, a water element crab
eat: snipping the food with its claws
bringing a claw to its mouth, bubbles rising
play: a small hop with claws up
thuy-giai.refuse: hiding its face behind its claws

thuy-long.who: Thuy Long, a water element dragon
eat: sucking the food in with a water swirl
play: swimming through the air with a water ribbon
shooting a water fountain upward happily
thuy-long.refuse: turning its head and puffing water

thuy-chien.who: Thuy Chien, a water element living water droplet warrior
eat: absorbing it into its watery body
the food visibly swirling inside it
play: turning into a curling wave mid-air
splash landing into a puddle shape
thuy-chien.sad: melting into a sad puddle shape

bao-thuy.who: Bao Thuy, a water element bubble creature
play: the bubble pops and it drops down

thuy-giao.who: Thuy Giao, a water element sea serpent
eat: eyes on the food, tongue flicking
swallowing it whole in one gulp
a lump sliding down its long neck
play: an S-shape high in the air
tail curled into a heart shape, cheering
thuy-giao.refuse: turning its head away, tongue out

tho-nguu.who: Tho Nguu, an earth element ox
eat: licking its nose with a long tongue, happy moo
play: skidding to a stop in a dust cloud
tho-nguu.petted: eyes closed, leaning in, tail swishing
tho-nguu.angry: steam snorting from its nostrils, horns lowered

tho-tuong.who: Tho Tuong, an earth element elephant
eat: trunk reaching down to the food
trunk curling to bring it to its mouth
trunk spraying a happy puff of dust
play: a heavy landing shaking the ground with dust

tho-tich.who: Tho Tich, an earth element lizard
tho-tich.sad: flat on the ground, chin down

thach-nhan.who: Thach Nhan, an earth element stone golem
thach-nhan.petted: moss blooming on its head, eyes closed

thanh-tri.who: Thanh Tri, an earth element little castle golem
eat: the food going into its gate
the tiny flag on top waving happily
thanh-tri.angry: steam puffing from the tower top

tho-long.who: Tho Long, an earth element dragon
eat: digging the food up with its claws
play: bursting up out of the ground with rocks
tho-long.refuse: turning its head and huffing dust
